fact: Naver announced a consortium with Nvidia, Nexus Core Systems and Lloyds Capital to build a 500 MW renewable-powered AI data centre in Morocco, with a first phase of a 40 MW AI supercomputer using Nvidia Blackwell GPUs due to start in Q4 2025 and TAQA supplying power.
title: Maroc: Consortium mondial lance un centre de données IA souverain de 500 MW
